# AGENTS.md

**Never modify `skills/` directly** — not even a typo fix. It is generated by
`./build.sh` from `src/` and committed only because the plugin installs from the
repo root. Edit `src/skills/<name>/` or `src/shared/`, run `./build.sh`, commit
`src/` and `skills/` together. CI fails when `skills/` differs from a fresh build.

Contributor notes (layout, build checks, evals, releasing): [.claude/CLAUDE.md](./.claude/CLAUDE.md).
